name: Ring of Energy Imbalance
body:
Aura faint (minor) or moderate (major or greater) abjuration; CL 3rd (minor), 7th (major), or 11th (greater); Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of energy resistance and functions as such against its specified energy type. All other energy attacks made against the wearer are intensified, however.

A minor ring of energy imbalance increases damage from the non-resisted energy types by 50% and grants 10 points of resistance to the specified energy type.
A major ring of energy imbalance increases damage from the specified energy type by 100% and grants 20 points of resistance to the specified energy type.
A greater ring of energy imbalance increases damage from the specified energy type by 200% and grants 30 points of resistance to the specified energy type.

This ring is destroyed if remove curse is cast upon it. Doing so causes the ring to explode in a wave of the energy type to which it had been attuned, dealing 5d6 points of damage to all individuals within 10 feet of the wearer. Succeeding a DC 15 Reflex will reduce this to half damage.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of energy resistance

Identification DC 28 (minor), DC 32 (major), DC 36 (greater)
False Identification DC 18 (minor), DC 22 (major), DC 26 (greater)
